$comment: T-3.16. A near miss is a round passing within nearMissM of a soldier's capsule SURFACE without hitting it; an impact counts within impactRadiusM of that surface (and a round that lands close has usually also passed close, so the two stack). Every raise is added to a level in 0..1 that holds for holdSeconds after the latest raise and then falls at decayPerSec. coneDeg is how much wider a human's weapon cone is at level 1 (linear below it); an AI's aim reads the level through its archetype's suppressionFactor instead.
